{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Thermal base top: fitted long-sleeve crew neck, hip length, soft ivory #efe9e1, fine merino wool

Thermal leggings: slim, full ankle length, worn under the trousers, charcoal #3b4250, merino-blend jersey

Sweater: refined roll neck, relaxed straight cut, hip length, soft blue #7fa6c8, extra-fine merino wool

Trousers: high-waisted straight leg, full length to the ankle bone, slate charcoal #3b4250, wool-blend flannel

Coat: long single-breasted padded coat with a stand collar, straight cut, below the knee, deep navy #1f2a44, dense wool blend with a warm insulated lining

Boots: flat ankle boots with a lugged rubber sole, waterproof and shearling-lined, black #1a1a1a, salt-resistant treated leather

Socks: tall thick socks, mid-calf, heather gray #8a8f99, merino wool

Hat: close-fitting folded-cuff beanie, light silver gray #c9ccd3, wool-cashmere knit

Scarf: long, wide, wrapped twice, dusty blue #9fb4cc, soft brushed wool

Gloves: lined, full-finger, wrist length, black #1a1a1a, leather with a wool lining

Why this works: Layers of merino and a padded wool coat keep you warm in deep frost while still reading as neat office dressing, with the roll neck and straight trousers giving a polished line. The cool blues, navy and charcoal echo your light eyes and silvery hair and flatter your fair skin. The flat, lugged, waterproof boots give grip and protection on snowy, salted pavements for the whole walk, with no heels.
